g.text: ORL fixed factorial study: sigma by context

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596776

g.text: Four methods, twenty predeclared splits, 320 fitted models; fixed settings within each method.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667485

g.text: Whiskers are split SD. The effects are descriptive on repeated images. Context improves CSA24, but reducing sigma under context lowers CSA390;
the settings are not jointly optimal for every method.
